steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: You're accusing me?

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: That's not what I meant...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: What about you? Are you going to accuse me too?

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: Come now, Raimund, no one's making any accusations...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: I didn't start any fires.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Then why are you here at this hour?

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: You don't pray with us. You don't come to the sacrarium. You... you people don't have any faith!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: We may not have faith. But that doesn't mean we have anything to do with the fire.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: I had some personal business that took me past this place. Believe me or don't.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: What sort of business?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Nothing to do with you.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Hey...!

steps.name: Fernand
steps.text: Enough. Is there some rule against us being here? You just want to accuse us of starting the fire, don't you?

steps.name: Fernand
steps.text: We shouldn't have helped them fight the fire. We should have let the place burn to the ground.

steps.name: Anxious Inhabitant
steps.text: What did you say?!

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: Fires have happened before, at this time of year. It could just be a coincidence.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: What a coincidence it would be! You there, didn't you say someone started the fire? Come here...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes, I believe this was an intentional act.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: And you think I did it?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: No, I don't.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: You're lying.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I have no reason to lie.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The fire spread quickly. It can be inferred that the arsonist was near the sacrarium.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: And Raimund was—

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Do not jump to conclusions. What I meant was that anyone who was near the scene is a suspect.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: That includes all of you, and myself.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Wh-What are you talking about?

steps.name: Calm Inhabitant
steps.text: You think we started the fire? We're Sankta. Why would we burn our own sacrarium?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Race is not proof of innocence. I would not hesitate to destroy the sacrarium, if I thought it necessary.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I did not find any evidence implicating this Sarkaz.

steps.name: Fernand
steps.text: Hmph, at least you're talking sense.

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Senior Federico is right... we can't accuse anybody without evidence.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: You're gonna just let this go?! It's the sacrarium! And all those flowers that you so painstakingly grew...

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: Please, that's enough!

steps.name: Clément
steps.text: I don't want to suspect any of us.

steps.name: Panicked Inhabitant
steps.text: Clément...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The arguing must stop.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The possibility of the Sankta burning their own sacrarium cannot be eliminated. I will continue to investigate until I discover the true culprit.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Hey, wing-man, about what just happened...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: You're the one who started all that, alright? You're the one who first said that someone started the fire!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: And you don't fully trust me, do you?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Can you give me a little more than that?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Ahem. Anyway, what I mean is...

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: ...Don't expect me to thank you.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: (He doesn't know how to say gratias, Sara.)

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: (Poor thing...)

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: (We can teach him! It's not hard.)

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: (But I'm a little scared of him...)

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Who are you saying doesn't know how to say gratias?!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Hey, wing-man! Where did these kids come from? I've never seen them before!

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You don't know them?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Should I?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Very good. I want to ask you about the Sarkaz population here, and about these two children.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: What? You...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I'll answer your questions.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Gerald! The fire...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I saw it all. You did well, Raimund.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: And... we meet again, Reverend Executor.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You were standing there for a long time. I thought you didn't intend to show your face.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Guess there's no hiding from you.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Why did you change your mind?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I believed you did not want to see me again.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Peace makes one timid.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Would you like to pay a visit to our place, Executor?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: We don't have much, but there's a place to sit down, and you can see with your own eyes how the Sarkaz live here.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: As for your questions... I'll do my best to answer them.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I haven't been so active in a long time. I've never been good at pursuit.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I've got you!

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: (Bizarre cry)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Quiet. This is a residential area. You'll bother the others.

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: (Growls)

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: Eat... hungry...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Oh, you can talk? This will be much easier if we can communicate.

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: (Strange roar)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I guess it's not that simple.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm sorry, but you'll have to stay put. It's dangerous.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'll contact the Iberian Inquisition. I'm sure they know more about you than I would. If you're really sapient, maybe you can talk to their priests...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Who's that?!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Stop right there!
I must ask you to stay.
The night is cut open by a pulse of light.
Lemuen feels a heavy weight that forces her gun down.
The shadow that wields the light stands silently, drawing back the exotic sword before the gun that is slowly pointing towards him.
As the clouds disperse to reveal the moon, Lemuen begins to see who it is.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Well, there have been a lot of unwelcome visitors today.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Can I ask you to stop bothering me? I will be very, very angry if someone gets hurt because we wasted too much time here.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I'm afraid I cannot give way.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I must ask you not to stop that pitiful soul.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A noise. Source unclear.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You don't have a lot of people.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: More than you think. Some went out and haven't returned.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: It's getting late. Go back and have some rest.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Are you sure we're leaving tomorrow? Some people haven't come back yet.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: We follow the plan as it is. We set out tomorrow morning.

steps.name: Cautious Sarkaz Inhabitant
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Senior Federico.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: I'm sleepy...

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: I'm sleepy, and hungry too!

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Are you gonna take us home?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: I want to go home... I want Mamma...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Have gone all day without food?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Mamma never eats. She says she's not hungry.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: But we haven't eaten today. My tummy hurts.

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: It's so weird.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: It's not weird. Food is one of the body's basic needs, and being deprived of it leads to discomfort and pain.

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: That's so complicated!

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Is it normal to feel pain if you don't eat?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Has Mamma been hurting when she doesn't eat?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: If what you say is true, yes, your mother has been suffering physical torment.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Enough, Reverend Executor!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This is a fact.

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Waaaaaahhh...

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Uwaaaahh!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Sometimes, the truth is better left unsaid.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: *sniffles*...

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Is Mamma hurting now?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I cannot confirm your mother's current status.
The Executor kneels down. No one pays attention to the dirt on the edge of his robe, and the adornments that represent his status.
Federico Giallo gazes straight into the children's eyes.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I am here as an executor of the Notarial Hall to investigate the truth of what is happening here at the monastery, and to maintain its peace and order.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The disappearance of an inhabitant is within the scope of my mission.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: You'll help us find Mamma?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes, I will find your mother.

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Estara & Erendel
steps.text: Yay!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: I never would've thought...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Will you leave these children in my care for now, Reverend Executor?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I cannot make the decision for them.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Will you go with this young man over here, children?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: But I have to... well, I guess I can do it, now that the sacrarium's all burned up.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: (It's the one even scarier than Senior Federico.)

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: (Yeah, he's so scary...)

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: You two...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: That will do, Raimund.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: He'll take you kids to supper, then it's off to bed, okay?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: But I want to stay with Senior Federico...

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Sara, Federico's busy! We need to be good.

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: O-Okay, we'll go with the scary guy...

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Hahaha!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Boss!

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: A-Ahem.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Can you get the kids something to eat, then put them to bed?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: I can... but where do I take them?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Hyman's house.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Hyman's? I guess there's nobody there right now... but what if Hyman comes back tonight?

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: It'll be fine.

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Alright, then.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: See you tomorrow, Senior Federico!

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: I hope we find Mamma tomorrow...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I will come for you in the morning.

steps.name: Erendel
steps.text: Yay! Good night, Senior Federico.

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Senior Federico, Senior Federico...

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: I-I can't reach you!

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Come down a little lower!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Estara
steps.text: G-Good night!

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Gerald
steps.text: Quite the lady's man, aren't you?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Kids these days... what's so great about that guy?

steps.name: Raimund
steps.text: Hey, wait up, you two! Don't run!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: ...Good night.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I thought this was going to be an easy trip, almost like a vacation, welcoming some brethren back to Laterano. It didn't sound hard at all, did it?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Well, I guess I did have to deal with Oren.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: But that wasn't too much of a problem. It's not like you can't talk to him.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Certainly, your skills with a gun can solve many problems.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Not quite enough to deal with you, though.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: You flatter me.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm not flattering you... should I call you Father?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You came to protect that... curious visitor of ours, didn't you? I suppose you're from Iberia?

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You wear a cleric's robe, but you feel completely different to believers of the Lateran faith.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: You're sharp.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Honest, aren't you?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I won't beat around the bush, then. I don't normally like to be so direct, but...

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Not one more step forward. Leave, now.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You are not fit to set foot in Paradise.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't comply.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I am needed here, for a little longer.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (Tough customer.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (An unusual sword. The style is Iberian...)

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Your attacks are even sharper than your words.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I still harbor hope for mutual understanding, but I concede that you're acting appropriately, given your position.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I'm curious, though... how do you define Paradise?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: A place where everyone lives in peace and happiness.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Preferably with less unwelcome visitors.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Would you call this place Paradise, then?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You're enjoying this chit-chat, aren't you?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: A group of people have found peace away from the world for sixty years. What do you call this, if not Paradise?

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Even if their lives are endless cold, hunger and suffering?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: They may be wanting for material comforts... but it's far from endless.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Ah, yes. Laterano will bring salvation. The hard days will soon come to an end.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: At the price of abandoning some.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: ...This isn't anyone's fault.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Please, don't get me wrong. I'm not accusing anyone.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: But I've been thinking: What is the difference between us? Is it physical, or something else?

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: From the individual's very birth, all that makes us who we are causes our thinking to go in divergent ways and reach divergent conclusions...

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Is there really such a thing as mutual understanding within this?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Are you really going to ask this to a Sankta?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You could try it yourself in your next life, if you happen to become a Sankta.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: ...*cough*!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (This has taken too long. Can't let that thing attack the residents.)

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: (I need to take care of this quickly...)

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: No need to be anxious. I don't really plan on doing anything.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I'm here because my kin need help.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You sound sincere, but I'm not in a position to trust you.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: You're as stubborn as a former student of mine. It can be a virtue, but it can also be trouble.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm curious about a student who could cause you trouble.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: One of the best I've ever had. We never saw each other again, after he left Iberia.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I didn't want to do this... I'm so getting in trouble for it.

spans.text: I didn't want to do this... I'm

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Negotiations failed.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Can't say I regret it.
Lemuen movement is as light as her voice.
She pushes away the movement-aiding device beneath her. The lamp that hung on the handle sways in the night wind, falls, then shatters.
Light leaks out haphazardly, splashing on the silhouette slowly standing up in front.
The dark veil of night is lifted.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: You can stand?

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Not yet, really.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Rehabilitation is going to get longer, and I'm going to get scolded.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: *hiss*

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: I trust you won't push yourself too hard.

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: You're not in good physical shape, nor are you used to this kind of battle—

steps.name: Aulus
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Thanks for the compliment. That was aimed for your mouth.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: The people tune out the sermon, when it gets too long.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: Especially if they're already fuming after a long and not very good day.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I think I can justify my response based on the provocation.
The cardinal aide narrows her eyes. The facade of meekness that built up from years of being bedridden falls apart in the sound of her gun being loaded.
Lemuen's light laugh has no warmth in it.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'm tired. Let's do this quick.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: I'll say it again—

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: —Get out of my way, Father.

steps.name: Lemuen
steps.text: You may not set foot in Paradise.

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: Hungry... so hungry...

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: Eat...
The thin door plank is pushed open from the outside.
The children are still sleeping.
The cold wind pours into the tiny, battered house through the gap. The unknown threat sneaks in soundlessly, and slowly approaches...

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: Eat...

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: Hungry... eat, eat...

steps.name: Twisted Monster
steps.text: Oh... oh...
